mapper.select: SELECT deal.P_TRADE_ID pTradeId, todo.TASK_ID, todo.BOOKSET_ID, todo.BOOKSET_DATE, todo.HAPPEN_DATE, todo.BOOK_DATE FROM BOK_BATCH_TASK_TODO todo INNER JOIN BOK_BOOKSET M ON todo.BOOKSET_ID = M.BOOKSET_ID INNER JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING acc ON acc.BOOKSET_ID = todo.BOOKSET_ID AND acc.HAPPEN_DATE = todo.HAPPEN_DATE AND acc.BOOK_DATE = todo.BOOK_DATE INNER JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL deal ON acc.BUSI_NO = deal.TRADE_ID AND acc.BUSI_TABLE = '02' AND deal.TRADE_STATUS = '03' WHERE todo.SEQ_NO = #{seqNo} AND todo.BOOKSET_DATE = #{BOOKSET_DATE} AND todo.BOOK_DATE = #{BOOK_DATE} AND todo.HAPPEN_DATE = #{HAPPEN_DATE} AND todo.TASK_ID = #{taskId} AND todo.IS_SUB_BOOKSET = #{IS_SUB_BOOKSET} UNION ALL SELECT deal.P_ORDER_ID pTradeId, todo.TASK_ID, todo.BOOKSET_ID, todo.BOOKSET_DATE, todo.HAPPEN_DATE, todo.BOOK_DATE FROM BOK_BATCH_TASK_TODO todo INNER JOIN BOK_BOOKSET M ON todo.BOOKSET_ID = M.BOOKSET_ID INNER JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING acc ON acc.BOOKSET_ID = todo.BOOKSET_ID AND acc.HAPPEN_DATE = todo.HAPPEN_DATE AND acc.BOOK_DATE = todo.BOOK_DATE INNER JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING_DETAIL detail ON acc.BOOKSET_ID = detail.BOOKSET_ID AND acc.BUSI_NO = detail.BUSI_NO AND acc.BUSI_TABLE = detail.BUSI_TABLE INNER JOIN STL_ORDERS deal ON acc.BUSI_NO = deal.ORDER_ID AND acc.BUSI_TABLE = '01' AND deal.ORDER_STATUS = '03' WHERE todo.SEQ_NO = #{seqNo} AND todo.BOOKSET_DATE = #{BOOKSET_DATE} AND todo.BOOK_DATE = #{BOOK_DATE} AND todo.HAPPEN_DATE = #{HAPPEN_DATE} AND todo.TASK_ID = #{taskId} AND todo.IS_SUB_BOOKSET = #{IS_SUB_BOOKSET}
